entities.name: WWII & the Holocaust in Hungary

entities.summary: Hungary's entry into WWII alongside the Axis, the disastrous Second Army destruction at the Don (1943), Arrow Cross takeover (October 1944), the deportation and murder of 565,000 Hungarian Jews, and the devastating Siege of Budapest (1944–45).
